notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null and the R1 hardware backend was never opened. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper is PythonObjectDriver, but the Em2 client exposes properties plus per-channel command paths and multi-step acquisition methods that a family command table cannot express; the package is a decorated direct Driver over sardana_albaem.ctrl.em2:Em2, which the card's direct-driver decision permits. NOT COVERED: the buffered acquisition arrays from Em2.read() (ACQU:MEAS?) and the ZMQ streaming path (ZmqStreamReceiver). The driver exposes the instant current of each channel and the scalar acquisition and trigger settings. nb_points and trigger_delay have no bound in the clone and are Limit.operator_required; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, not a device fact. The per-channel range and inversion are set by x-cap.maxiv-kitscontrols.configure_channel.v1 because keeping them in cap.device.configure.v1 made the single configure tool exceed the 2048-byte limit; their limits are unchanged. No independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone and none is claimed; the e-stop and the safe-state action call Em2.stop_acquisition() (ACQU:STOP True).
